updates.title: Purview Data Loss Prevention: Integration with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to enforce DLP policies at the network layer, protecting text, files, and AI interactions across browsers, apps, APIs, and cloud applications. This extends DLP enforcement beyond Microsoft 365 to detect risky activity and prevent sensitive data leakage to untrusted SaaS platforms, social media, and generative AI services.

updates.title: Purview Compliance Portal: Diagnostics Access Expanded to Multiple Admin Roles
updates.summary: Microsoft has expanded access to Purview Compliance Portal Diagnostics beyond Global Admin to include Compliance Administrator, Security Administrator, and Organization Management roles. This enables broader troubleshooting and operational visibility for role-scoped admins without requiring global privileges.

updates.title: Purview DLP: Upgraded Inline Protection for Entra-Managed Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview is enhancing inline data protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business with tighter Conditional Access integration, expanded condition combinations, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, and activity explorer visibility. This simplifies policy configuration while removing previous restrictions on policy flexibility.

updates.title: Purview DLP: Expanded Inline Protection for Unmanaged AI Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview's inline DLP protection for Edge for Business is expanding to support a much broader set of unmanaged generative AI apps, allowing admins to detect and protect sensitive data shared through browser activities. This extends consistent data security controls across more SaaS destinations without requiring new policy infrastructure.

updates.title: Purview DLP: User-Based Aggregation of DLP Alerts
updates.summary: DLP alert aggregation is being enhanced to group alerts by common entities (users) even when multiple rules match, consolidating related violations into single alert objects. This reduces alert noise, simplifies investigation workflows, and improves context for security teams reviewing violations.

updates.title: Purview Insider Risk Management: Data Security Investigations Integration
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management is gaining the ability to launch pre-scoped Data Security Investigations directly from IRM cases, allowing data security admins to view content analysis for risky users and assess post-incident data impact. This tightens the feedback loop between insider risk detection and downstream forensic investigation.

updates.title: Purview Insider Risk Management: Support for Collection Policies
updates.summary: Purview now integrates collection policies with Insider Risk Management, allowing admins to scope Sensitive Information Types and activities for specific users to ensure IRM policies detect the right behavior signals. This requires review of existing collection policies to align with IRM coverage needs.

updates.title: Purview Information Protection: Sensitivity Label Support in Engage
updates.summary: Admins can now manually apply Information Protection sensitivity labels in Engage communities, enabling data classification and protection through privacy and external access controls. This extends label governance to the Engage platform alongside existing Microsoft 365 applications.

updates.title: Purview Endpoint DLP: Full Path Display in Activity Explorer
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP Activity Explorer now displays the complete path of target domains instead of just domain names, improving visibility and investigation accuracy for DLP incidents. This enhancement helps security teams more precisely track data exfiltration destinations.

updates.title: Purview DSPM: Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer Capabilities
updates.summary: Purview Data Security Posture Management is introducing copilot readiness assessments and a data explorer to help security teams evaluate data readiness for Microsoft Copilot, identify sensitive data exposure and oversharing, and prioritize remediation efforts. These tools consolidate data risk visibility in one place.

updates.title: Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
updates.summary: A new unified interface consolidates all Purview classifiers—Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into one discovery, creation, validation, and management hub. This simplifies classifier management and governance across the compliance platform.

updates.title: Purview DLP: Policies for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps
updates.summary: Data Loss Prevention now supports policies for non-Microsoft connected applications such as Box and Google Workspace, leveraging existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors and the same classification engine. This extends DLP enforcement to third-party SaaS platforms at rest.

updates.title: Purview Endpoint DLP: Preparing for macOS Permission Changes
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP admins must deploy client version 101.26072 or later to prepare for upcoming macOS permission model changes, including configuration of protection modes and Device Control permission status monitoring. Early deployment is critical to avoid disruptions to data protection enforcement on Apple devices.

updates.title: Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Automatic Delay Hold for Inactive Mailboxes
updates.summary: When the last hold is removed from an inactive mailbox, Microsoft 365 now automatically applies a 30-day delay hold to preserve the inactive status during hold transition. Admins should review delay holds before recalculating mailbox hold status to avoid unintended mailbox reactivation.

updates.title: Purview Data Lifecycle Management: Priority Cleanup for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Priority Cleanup enables permanent deletion of SharePoint and OneDrive files after simulation, review, and approval, bypassing recycle bins and removing files from search discoverability. This provides admins more aggressive data retention enforcement options for compliance scenarios.

updates.title: Microsoft Edge: 12 Authorization Vulnerabilities in Chromium Components Patched
updates.summary: Microsoft Edge has patched 12 authorization and access control vulnerabilities inherited from upstream Chromium, affecting CORS, FileSystem, DevTools, WebUI, Network, Loader, Updater, ControlledFrame, and FileAPI components. Admins should ensure Edge is updated to the latest version to close these potential bypass and privilege escalation risks.
